summary: Tested Google Login integration end-to-end. Backend /api/auth/google/session endpoint works correctly (returns 401 'Invalid session' for bad session_id, 422 for missing field). Google login buttons visible on both /login and /register with proper Google icon SVG and 'Continue with Google' text. Clicking Google button correctly redirects to https://auth.emergentagent.com/oauth/?redirect=<origin>/library with /library as the redirect target. Existing email/password admin login still works and stores auth_token in localStorage. Guest login still works and navigates to /library with browsing-as-guest banner. All 8 pytest backend tests pass. All 6 requested feature checks pass.
critical_code_review_comments: Google session endpoint correctly uses `{'_id': 0}` projection to avoid MongoDB ObjectId serialization issues.
Backend endpoint properly handles both new user creation and existing user linking (google_linked flag).
Frontend uses window.location.origin dynamically for redirect URL - correct, no hardcoded URLs.
AuthCallback.jsx uses a ref (hasProcessed) to guard against React StrictMode double-invocation of the session exchange - good practice.
server.py is 3663 lines - consider splitting into modules (auth, books, subscriptions, admin) for maintainability. Not blocking.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Google OAuth implementation is fully working at UI + backend level. The actual OAuth handshake with Google via auth.emergentagent.com cannot be tested end-to-end without real Google credentials, but every layer we can test is verified: (1) Buttons render correctly, (2) Redirect URL is correctly formed, (3) Backend session-exchange endpoint reachable and validates session_ids properly, (4) Existing email/password + guest flows unaffected.

google_btn_on_login_page.details: Visible with Google SVG icon and 'Continue with Google' text. data-testid='google-login-btn'.

google_btn_on_register_page.details: Visible with Google SVG icon and 'Continue with Google' text. data-testid='google-signup-btn'.

backend_google_session_endpoint_invalid.details: POST /api/auth/google/session with session_id='test_invalid' returns 401 with detail 'Invalid session'.

backend_google_session_endpoint_missing_.details: Returns 422 pydantic validation error when session_id is missing.

email_password_admin_login.details: Login with huzaifahwaheed70@gmail.com/admin123 succeeds, JWT token stored in localStorage, user redirected to /library, books load (46 books).

guest_login.details: Guest button navigates to /library, shows 'You're browsing as a guest' banner and 'Browsing as Guest' toast.
